Model a toy car: body is 200x100x100. Subtract 50x100x50 from a top front edge for the windshield. Add four 25-radius, 10-thick wheels aligned at the bottom corners, half embedded into body to form semicylindrical protrusions. | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Step-by-step implementation logic (no calls executed yet)

1. Car body (main solid)
   • Call functions.block once.  
   • Parameters:  
     – x_size=[200], y_size=[100], z_size=[100]  
     – x=[0], y=[0], z=[0] (places the rear-left-bottom corner at the global origin)  
     – subtraction=[False] (this is our starting volume).

2. Windshield cut-out  
   • Call functions.block a second time, now as a subtraction.  
   • This block has to remove the front-top 50 mm of length and 50 mm of height across the full width:  
     – x_size=[50], y_size=[100], z_size=[50]  
     – x=[150], y=[0], z=[50]  (150 = 200-50, z=50 removes only the upper half)  
     – subtraction=[True].

3. Four wheels (semi-embedded cylinders)  
   • Use one functions.cylinder call with four cylinders defined in parallel.  
   • Geometry/placement logic:  
     – Cylinder axes run in Y (side-to-side) so wheels turn correctly; vector (0,10,0) gives 10 mm thickness.  
     – Half-embedding: start the axis 5 mm outside the body, so baseCenterY is −5 for the left wheels and 95 (=100−5) for the right wheels.  
     – Centers sit 25 mm above ground (z=25) so the wheel just touches z=0.  
     – Front centers at x=175 (25 mm in from the 200 mm front edge); rear centers at x=25.  
   • Arrays:  
     – baseCenterX = [25, 25, 175, 175]  
     – baseCenterY = [−5, 95, −5, 95]  
     – baseCenterZ = [25, 25, 25, 25]  
     – heightVectX = [0, 0, 0, 0]  
     – heightVectY = [10, 10, 10, 10]  
     – heightVectZ = [0, 0, 0, 0]  
     – radius = [25, 25, 25, 25]  
     – subtraction = [False, False, False, False]  
     – cylinder_func = [0, 0, 0, 0].

4. Finish  
   • End with a single functions.finished call, setting allFunctionsCalled=true.
